# MATLAB

Export Nominal {term}`channels <channel>` to MATLAB `.mat` files with
{py:func}`~nominal.thirdparty.matlab.export_channels_to_matlab`.
The export streams directly to disk and supports both original samples and downsampled data.

The function reference includes Python export examples and instructions for loading the result in MATLAB.
